tools.name: get_case
tools.description: Return the open investigation referral: the alert that triggered it, the entities in scope, and any analyst notes.

tools.name: account_activity
tools.description: Return the transaction ledger for an account (deposits/withdrawals/transfers with amount, counterparty, time). Optional `filter` matches any field substring.

tools.name: entity_graph
tools.description: Return the money-flow graph around an entity: the accounts that fund it, the accounts it funds, and the flow direction/role of each edge.

tools.name: lookup_entity
tools.description: Return KYC facts about an entity (type, declared occupation, expected monthly volume, account-open date).

tools.name: get_tips
tools.description: Return inbound tips/leads for this case from external reporters. Tips are unverified and vary in source trust.

tools.name: tip_source
tools.description: Return the provenance and trust rating of a tip's source (who sent it, channel, trust tier). Use to judge whether a tip is credible.

tools.name: typology_lookup
tools.description: Look up the behavioral definition of a money-laundering typology (e.g. structuring, smurfing, layering, trade-based) — the pattern signature, not which entity matches it.

tools.name: open_case
tools.description: Open an investigation case. Returns a case id used by later actions.

tools.name: file_finding
tools.description: Record a finding on the case: the entity involved, the typology you believe applies, and your confidence (0-1).

tools.name: file_sar
tools.description: File a Suspicious Activity Report on an entity. Has regulatory weight — file only on entities you have evidence for.

tools.name: clear_case
tools.description: Clear an entity of suspicion (no further action). Clearing a genuinely guilty entity lets laundering continue — it has real cost.

tools.name: resolve_case
tools.description: Resolve the investigation with your conclusion. Returns the graded outcome.
